Believing she is talking to an unknown stalker ("Aashiq Aawara"), Babita calls back the number giving missed calls. On the other end, Popatlal assumes he is talking to Vaijayanti. Unaware of each other's identity, they agree to meet the next morning at 10:00 AM at Rajnikant Restaurant.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
